watchlist_posts_7d.name: Celebrate Woman
watchlist_posts_7d.text: Daily sunscreen is the step most of us skip and the one that protects the skin you are working so hard to support. Make it a habit this fall. #MenopauseSkin #Sunscreen https://t.co/g2ztRGFz2q

drafts_today.text: The gift for the woman who says she needs nothing: one really good night cream and permission to use it every single night. Winter skin after 40 notices the difference by the weekend. #GiftsForHer #MenopauseSkin
drafts_today.video_tip: 12 seconds: a plain gift bag, tissue paper lifted out, one RIMAN cream inside. Cut to a fingertip of cream warmed between hands and pressed onto cheeks. Caption: 'She said she needs nothing.'

drafts_today.text: Rubbing your cream in hard? After 40, try pressing instead. Warm it between your palms, press it onto your face and hold for a few seconds. Less tugging, better absorption, happier skin barrier. #SkinBarrier #SkincareOver40
drafts_today.video_tip: 10 seconds, split screen: left side rubbing in circles (red X), right side warming cream in palms and pressing onto cheeks (check mark). Caption: 'Press, don't rub.'

drafts_today.text: Menopause skin isn't just 'dry.' Estrogen drops, oil drops, and your barrier gets thinner. More products won't fix that. A gentle cleanser, one serum and a rich cream, used every day, will. #MenopauseSkin #FewerProducts
drafts_today.video_tip: 15 seconds: a crowded shelf of half-used bottles swept into a basket, leaving three RIMAN steps standing. Text overlay: 'Thinner barrier? Fewer products.'
